description: Election Commission - Jayasekara Liyanage Jayantha Was Selected as the Member of the Katuwana Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Katuwana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to loss of party membership, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
